answer: To resist Sybil attacks, the protocol enforces a quadratic stake-burning curve $C(n) = k \cdot n^2$ whenever an agent registers identities. Rather than allowing ephemeral swarms to dart through like a fleeting comet, the network traps unverified actors behind a glacier of cold-locked capital. Generating thousands of dark, sable pseudonyms imposes superlinear economic friction, rendering mass identity forging mathematically unprofitable.
